name: netsignal
description: Internet signal bars (latency to api.anthropic.com + periodic bandwidth) in the Claude Code status line.

style.title: Style
style.description: bars, short (+ ms) or full (+ Mbps)

badMs.title: Bad below (ms)
badMs.description: One bar under this latency, none above

timeoutSec.title: Timeout (s)
timeoutSec.description: A latency probe with no answer within this shows as timeout

latencyUrl.title: Latency URL
latencyUrl.description: Time to this URL is the latency

bandwidthUrl.title: Bandwidth URL
bandwidthUrl.description: A ~3 MB download timed for bandwidth

desktopPlacement.title: Desktop placement
desktopPlacement.description: Where the desktop app shows the signal: pill (above the prompt), footer (status line beside the model) or both

pillStyle.title: Pill style
pillStyle.description: How the desktop pill looks: soft (pastel), outline, solid or dark
